arxiv-2201-00963.title: Spectrum of the transfer matrices of the spin chains associated with the A 3 ( 2 ) A^{(2)}_{3} Lie algebra
arxiv-2201-00963.description: Abstract We study the exact solution of quantum integrable system associated with the A 3 ( 2 ) A^{(2)}_{3} twist Lie algebra, where the boundary reflection matrices have non-diagonal elements thus the U ⁡ ( 1 ) U(1) symmetry is broken. With the help of the fusion technique, we obtain the closed recursive relations of the fused transfer matrices.

arxiv-2208-14556.title: Distinct electride-like nature of infinite-layer nickelates and the resulting theoretical challenges to calculate their electronic structure
arxiv-2208-14556.creator: Kateryna Foyevtsova, Ilya Elfimov, George A. Sawatzky
arxiv-2208-14556.description: Abstract We demonstrate in this paper that the recently discovered infinite-layer (IL) nickelates have much in common with a class of materials known as electrides. Oxide based electrides are compounds in which topotactic removal of loosely bound oxygens leaves behind voids with a landscape of attractive potentials for electrons.

arxiv-2301-00856.title: Gaussian Blur and Relative Edge Response
arxiv-2301-00856.creator: Austn C. Bergstrom, David Conran, David W. Messinger
arxiv-2301-00856.description: Abstract It is often convenient to use Gaussian blur in studying image quality or in data augmentation pipelines for training convoluional neural networks. Because of their convenience, Guassians are sometimes used as first order approximations of optical point spread functions.

arxiv-2307-15320.title: Robust visual sim-to-real transfer for robotic manipulation
arxiv-2307-15320.creator: Ricardo Garcia, Robin Strudel, Shizhe Chen, Etienne Arlaud, Ivan Laptev, Cordelia Schmid
arxiv-2307-15320.description: Abstract Learning visuomotor policies in simulation is much safer and cheaper than in the real world. However, due to discrepancies between the simulated and real data, simulator-trained policies often fail when transferred to real robots. One common approach to bridge the visual sim-to-real domain gap is domain randomization (DR).

arxiv-2412-20422.title: Bringing Objects to Life: training-free 4D generation from 3D objects through view consistent noise
arxiv-2412-20422.creator: Ohad Rahamim, Ori Malca, Dvir Samuel, Gal Chechik
arxiv-2412-20422.description: Abstract Recent advancements in generative models have enabled the creation of dynamic 4D content — 3D objects in motion — based on text prompts, which holds potential for applications in virtual worlds, media, and gaming. Existing methods provide control over the appearance of generated content, including the ability to animate 3D objects.

arxiv-2506-13659.title: Counting homomorphisms in antiferromagnetic graphs via Lorentzian polynomials
arxiv-2506-13659.creator: Joonkyung Lee, Jaeseong Oh, Jaehyeon Seo
arxiv-2506-13659.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Joonkyung Lee, Jaeseong Oh, Jaehyeon Seo. An edge-weighted graph G G , possibly with loops, is said to be antiferromagnetic if it has nonnegative weights and at most one positive eigenvalue, counting multiplicities. The number of graph homomorphisms from a graph H H to an antiferromagnetic graph G G generalises various important parameters in graph theory, including the number of independent sets and proper vertex-colourings, as well as their relaxations in statistical physics.

arxiv-2511-19253.title: MAESTRO: Multi-Agent Environment Shaping through Task and Reward Optimization
arxiv-2511-19253.creator: Boyuan Wu
arxiv-2511-19253.description: Abstract Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) is fundamentally constrained by two design bottlenecks: the manual engineering of dense reward functions and the difficulty of constructing curricula that prevent local optima in high-dimensional state spaces. Existing solutions typically rely on static, hand-crafted heuristics that struggle to generalize.

arxiv-2601-14184.title: Sparse Statistical Modeling in Condensed Matter Physics
arxiv-2601-14184.creator: J. McGee, S.V. Dordevic
arxiv-2601-14184.description: Abstract In this work we explore the possibility of using sparse statistical modeling in condensed matter physics. The procedure is employed to two well known problems: elemental superconductors and heavy fermions, and was shown that in most cases performs better than other AI methods, such as machine or deep learning.

europmc-pmc8685279.title: Signal pathways of melanoma and targeted therapy.
europmc-pmc8685279.creator: Guo W, Wang H, Li C.
europmc-pmc8685279.description: Melanoma is the most lethal skin cancer that originates from the malignant transformation of melanocytes. Although melanoma has long been regarded as a cancerous malignancy with few therapeutic options, increased biological understanding and unprecedented innovations in...

pmc-11449742.title: Prognosis of colorectal cancer, prognostic index of immunogenic cell death associated genes in response to immunotherapy, and potential therapeutic effects of ferroptosis inducers
pmc-11449742.creator: Mengjie Lei, Meihua Xiao, Zhiqing Long, Taolin Lin, Ran Ding, Qi Quan
pmc-11449742.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionThis study leverages bioinformatics and medical big data to integrate datasets from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) and The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), providing a comprehensive overview of immunogenic cell death (ICD)-related gene expression in colorectal cancer (CRC).

pmc-11470751.title: ELiAH: the atlas of E3 ligases in human tissues for targeted protein degradation with reduced off-target effect
pmc-11470751.creator: Hyojung Paik, Chunryong Oh, Sajid Hussain, Sangjae Seo, Soon Woo Park, Tae Lyun Ko, Ari Lee
pmc-11470751.description: The development of therapeutic agents has mainly focused on designing small molecules to modulate target proteins or genes which are conventionally druggable. Therefore, targeted protein degradation (TPD) for undruggable cases has emerged as promising pharmaceutical approach. TPD, often referred PROTACs (PROteolysis TArgeting Chimeras), uses a linker to degrade target proteins by hijacking the ubiquitination system.

pmc-12361548.title: European countries policy responses against SARS-Cov-2 in the context of vaccinations
pmc-12361548.creator: Arianna Agosto, Paola Cerchiello, Siegfried Eisenberg, Thomas Czypionka
pmc-12361548.description: Non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) are essential tools for containing or mitigating the spread of a novel virus until vaccination becomes available. Given their well-known side effects, NPIs should be employed only as long as necessary and largely replaced by population immunity through vaccination. During the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic, countries adopted various strategies for implementing NPIs and administering vaccinations.

pmc-12532678.title: Sex-specific differences in urinary incontinence associated factors in older adults: an analysis of the German health update study (GEDA 2019/2020-EHIS)
pmc-12532678.creator: Leila Irik, Alexander Winter, Falk Hoffmann
pmc-12532678.description: PurposeUrinary incontinence (UI) is a common condition with significant health and societal implications, particularly among older adults. This study aims to analyze sex-specific differences in associated factors among adults aged 55+.MethodsData from the cross-sectional German Health Update Study (GEDA 2019/2020-EHIS), conducted April 2019 to September 2020, were analyzed for participants aged 55 + years.

pmc-12573938.title: Clinical characteristics and surgical management of rare thoracic myelolipoma: experience from a single center with literature review
pmc-12573938.creator: Zeguang Ye, Xi Wu, Can Fang, Mingchuang Zhu, Peng Xiong, Min Zhu
pmc-12573938.description: BackgroundMyelolipoma is a rare benign tumor composed of mature adipose and hematopoietic tissue, most commonly occurring in the adrenal glands. Thoracic myelolipoma is extremely uncommon, particularly when originating in the lung or chest wall, and is frequently misdiagnosed due to its nonspecific clinical and radiological features.

pmc-12742147.title: Prevalence of sexual dysfunction and the associated factors among postpartum women who visit Debre Tabor Comprehensive Specialized Hospital, Northwest Ethiopia in 2024: a facility-based cross-sectional study
pmc-12742147.creator: Selamawit Girma Tadesse, Addisu Molla Abeje, Shimeles Biru, Rahel Amare Shumet, Adugna Gedefaw Alemu, Hiwot Dejen Fekadie, Belaynew Alemye Mengistie, Dessie Alemnew, Dagne Addisu, Abirham Wallelign Bayabil, Besfat Berihun Erega, Begizew Yimenu Mekuria, Assefa Kebie Mitiku, Tegegne Wale Belachew, Get
pmc-12742147.description: BackgroundSexual dysfunction is a common yet often neglected issue affecting the quality of life of postpartum women. It encompasses problems with desire, arousal, lubrication, orgasm, satisfaction and pain. The postpartum period is the transition from pregnancy and childbirth back to a non-pregnant physiological state and this change may affect a woman’s sexual health.

pmc-13244547.title: Nonuniform Chemical Passivation Dynamics in Monolayer MoS2 from Real-Time Photoluminescence Imaging
pmc-13244547.creator: Juhwan Lim, Jiho Han, Nicolas Gauriot, Zhaojun Li, Jung-In Lee, Christoph Schnedermann, Manish Chhowalla, Akshay Rao
pmc-13244547.description: Postchemical treatment is a major strategy for improving the optical and electronic performance of two-dimensional transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), where surface defects and unintentional doping limit radiative recombination. Despite its broad application, the passivation dynamics in both time and space remain insufficiently understood.

pmc-13540818.creator: Musarrat Jabeen Rahman, Syeda Nurunnahar, Mahbubur Rahman, Laura H. Kwong, Peter J. Winch
pmc-13540818.description: BackgroundFood hygiene is a critical but underemphasized link in fecal–oral disease transmission in dense informal settlements. A mesh-walled meatsafe, designed to exclude insects, animals, and young children while allowing ventilation, was distributed in a randomized controlled trial in Korail, Dhaka. Despite near-universal use (87.7–99.

pmc-13619444.title: The role of reduced sense of isolation in group-format PTSD treatment
pmc-13619444.creator: Diane Joss, Alexandra Comeau, Hanna Soumerai Rea, Adhithi Rajan, Martha Sweezy, Zev Schuman-Olivier
pmc-13619444.description: With increasing application of group-based interventions for PTSD, more research is needed on what might contribute to the therapeutic effects of group-based interventions. This study conducted secondary analyses with data from a previous randomized controlled trial, which compared two manualized 16-week videoconferencing PTSD treatments in a hybrid format with 16 group sessions and 8 individual sessions.

pmc-13630593.title: Study on spatial accessibility and supply-demand fit of public older adult care facilities in Guangzhou
pmc-13630593.creator: Xiu Chen, Lianhua Liu, Jiaxin Luo, Wentao Tan, Luocong Qi
pmc-13630593.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Against the backdrop of deepening aging population phenomenon, the coordination between the allocation of older adult care services and the needs of the older adult population has become a critical issue for optimizing urban public services.
